calc_items.title: Bedside Schwartz
calc_items.question: Height 105 cm, creatinine 0.70 mg/dL, constant 0.413. Estimate the eGFR.
calc_items.trap: Formula applies when stated; interpret age, assay and clinical chronicity.

calc_items.title: Corrected sodium
calc_items.question: Measured Na 130 mmol/L and glucose 500 mg/dL. Using the specified correction of +1.6 mmol/L per 100 mg/dL glucose above 100, compute the corrected Na.
calc_items.trap: The factor is stipulated for this arithmetic exercise; alternative factors may be used at marked hyperglycemia.

calc_items.title: Anion gap
calc_items.question: Na 142, Cl 111, HCO₃ 15 mmol/L. Calculate the uncorrected anion gap.
calc_items.trap: Correct for low albumin when clinically needed.

calc_items.title: Winter formula
calc_items.question: HCO₃ 14 mmol/L. What is the expected respiratory PCO₂ in metabolic acidosis?
calc_items.trap: Measured PCO₂ above the range indicates additional respiratory acidosis.

calc_items.title: D10 mass repair
calc_items.question: A 6.8-kg child is prescribed 5 mL/kg of 10% dextrose in a defined arithmetic scenario. Give the volume and the glucose mass.
calc_items.trap: Arithmetic only; the 5 mL/kg prescription is scenario-specific, not universal hypoglycemia guidance.

calc_items.title: Adenosine dose repair
calc_items.question: A stable child with regular narrow-complex SVT weighs 28 kg. Under a specified second-dose protocol of 0.2 mg/kg rapid IV/IO bolus, maximum 12 mg, calculate the dose.
calc_items.trap: Rapid IV/IO push followed by flush under ECG monitoring; avoid inappropriate use in irregular wide-complex/pre-excited AF; follow local PALS protocol.

calc_items.title: Arteriovenous O₂ difference
calc_items.question: Arterial oxygen content 18.2 mL/dL; mixed venous content 13.4 mL/dL. Calculate C(a−v)O₂.
calc_items.trap: The difference is not the same as arterial oxygen content; preserve units.
